spans.s:
mfn. (-डः-डा-डं)
Deaf.
E.
ईड to praise, आङ् prefixed, अच् or घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A ram.
2 A wild goat.
f. (-का)
A ewe.
E.
ईल to go, ण्वुल् affix; and ल changed to ड.

m. (-जः)
A medicinal plant, used for the cure of ringworms, (Cassia tora.)
E.
एड a sheep, गज to sound, अच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Deaf and dumb.
2 Wicked, perverse.
E.
एड deaf, and भूक dumb.
